definition: A prompt formulated around explicit guiding principles used to instruct a model (or an evaluator model) on how to critique or judge outputs according to those principles.
details: Constitutional prompts operationalize written principles (as in Constitutional AI) into concrete instructions a model can use for self-critique or evaluation, forming a building block of principle-based training pipelines.
story: Picture a parachute packed by a second pair of hands: nobody plans to need it, but everyone is glad it was checked. In plain words: A prompt formulated around explicit guiding principles used to instruct a model (or an evaluator model) on how to critique or judge outputs according to those principles. Here is how it actually plays out: Constitutional prompts operationalize written principles (as in Constitutional AI) into concrete instructions a model can use for self-critique or evaluation, forming a building block of principle-based training pipelines. Caution is not the enemy of progress — it is the reason progress gets to keep going. That deliberate caution is Constitutional Prompt.
